acf.beskrivelse:
Welcome to Saxovej — a newly renovated housing project offering bright and inviting 1-room apartments ranging from 32-34 m².

Here you’ll find modern apartments starting from just DKK 5,000/month.

The property offers a newly refurbished communal laundry room equipped with high-quality Miele machines, a large outdoor shared terrace perfect for relaxation and social gatherings, as well as on-site parking spaces available for residents.

The location is ideal for anyone seeking both peace and easy access to city life:

  • Only a 5-minute walk to Tarup Center, where you’ll find shopping opportunities and dining options.
  • The light rail is just around the corner, providing quick access to Odense city center and SDU.

This is a functional home in calm surroundings with everything you need right at your doorstep — perfect for students, singles, or commuters!

Adresse: Jacob Erlandsens Gade 4 Lejen er på 1.375 kr./md. Garagerne er 12/13 kvm  

Bemærk: Hvis du ikke bor i den ejendom, som parkeringen tilhører, pålægges der 25 % moms oven i lejen.

Den samlede pris er derfor 1.718,75 kr. inkl. moms.
